selection: Lowest validation MAE across predeclared feature sets and two fixed models; no tuning on benchmark
index_features: Latest assumed-available monthly value and trailing 3-month mean for each index; no centered smoothing, interpolation, or backward fill
index_availability: Assumed month-end + 15 days; not verified vintage release history. Latest available at issue date, source period must also end by weather input cutoff.
issue_dates: Weekly target Monday; monthly 10th of preceding month
local_weather: NASA T2M,RH2M,WS2M,PS,ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN: mean by target frequency, lag 2 and lag 3
models: Original scaled Ridge alpha=10, Random Forest 200 trees/depth3/leaf5/seed42
limitations: Current revised indices and NASA archives; anomaly reference climatologies may include later years. Not an operational as-issued hindcast. No significance claims, no API replacement.
